  • Payment & Team Confirmation: Complete 70% upfront payment and stay in touch with the Mr. Sewing team to confirm payment is done and receive your official start confirmation within 2 hours.
  • Measurements & Fabric: Provide your measurements (or choose our standard measurement methods) and confirm your fabric choice following our atelier guidelines.
